products.name: Classic with icing
products.shortDescription: Cinnamon and icing — nothing more, nothing less.
products.description: Our classic. Fluffy, moist yeast dough, rolled by hand with a butter-cinnamon filling and finished with icing. We bake it on site every day, right here in Wilda. The perfect place to start getting to know Słodko Mi.

images.alt: Classic cinnamon roll with a cinnamon swirl, drizzled with icing
Classic iced cinnamon roll on a white plate

seo.title: Classic Glazed Cinnamon Roll in Poznań
seo.description: Classic cinnamon roll: fluffy yeast dough, butter-cinnamon filling and sugar icing. Baked fresh daily in Wilda, Poznan. Eat in, take away or order on Wolt.

products.name: Classic with cream cheese
products.shortDescription: Creamy, with a thick layer of cream cheese frosting.
products.description: Our classic cinnamon roll with a butter-cinnamon filling, topped with a generous layer of cream cheese frosting. Creamy, soft and extra fluffy. Like all our cinnamon rolls, it's rolled by hand and baked fresh every day.

images.alt: Classic cinnamon roll under a thick layer of cream cheese frosting
Cinnamon roll with cream cheese frosting on a white plate

seo.title: Cream Cheese Cinnamon Roll in Poznań
seo.description: Classic cinnamon roll under a thick layer of cream cheese frosting. Baked fresh daily at Słodko Mi in Wilda, Poznan. Eat in, take away or order on Wolt.

products.name: Biscoff
products.description: A cinnamon roll for caramel-cookie lovers: a creamy topping, caramel glaze and a generous handful of crushed Biscoff cookies. Sweet, caramelly and crunchy.

images.alt: Biscoff cinnamon roll with cream, caramel glaze and crushed cookies
Biscoff cinnamon roll with a cookie crumb topping on a white plate

seo.title: Biscoff (Lotus) Cinnamon Roll in Poznań
seo.description: Biscoff cinnamon roll: creamy topping, caramel and crushed Biscoff (Lotus) cookies. Baked daily at Słodko Mi in Wilda, Poznan. Eat in or order on Wolt.

products.name: Oreo
products.shortDescription: Oreo cream, crushed cookies and milk chocolate.
products.description: A real treat for Oreo fans! Fluffy, pillowy yeast dough hides a butter-cinnamon filling with chunks of Oreo cookies. On top: silky Oreo cream and a generous helping of crushed cookies, all finished with a milk chocolate glaze.

images.alt: Oreo cinnamon roll with cream and crushed Oreo cookies
Oreo cinnamon roll with cream and crushed cookies on a white plate

seo.title: Oreo Cinnamon Roll with Chocolate, Poznań
seo.description: Oreo cinnamon roll: Oreo chunks in the filling, Oreo cream, crushed cookies and a milk chocolate glaze. Baked daily in Wilda, Poznan. Also on Wolt.

products.name: Szarlotka with crumble & caramel
products.description: Apples and cinnamon are a perfect match. This cinnamon roll tastes like homemade szarlotka, the Polish apple pie: with apples, crunchy crumble and caramel. One of our bestsellers.

images.alt: Szarlotka cinnamon roll with apples, crunchy crumble and caramel
Szarlotka cinnamon roll with crumble and caramel on a white plate

seo.title: Apple Crumble & Caramel Cinnamon Roll, Poznań
seo.description: Polish szarlotka (apple pie) in a cinnamon roll: apples, cinnamon, crunchy crumble and caramel. A bestseller, baked daily in Wilda, Poznan. Also on Wolt.

products.name: Sernik with strawberry & crumble
products.shortDescription: Cheesecake cream, strawberry, crumble and white chocolate.
products.description: This is no ordinary cinnamon roll. Sernik (Polish cheesecake) cream, strawberry, crumble and white chocolate — all on one roll. Packed with filling, fluffy and moist. One of our bestsellers.

images.alt: Strawberry sernik cinnamon roll with crumble and cheesecake cream

seo.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Cinnamon Roll, Poznań
seo.description: Strawberry cheesecake cinnamon roll: Polish sernik cream, strawberry, crumble and white chocolate. A bestseller, baked daily in Wilda, Poznan. On Wolt too.

products.name: Raspberry & coconut
products.shortDescription: Tangy and coconutty — a little taste of summer in a cinnamon roll.
products.description: Raspberry and coconut: tangy raspberries, cream and coconut flakes on a fluffy cinnamon roll. Fruity, creamy and a bit like summer — whatever the weather outside.
